description.value: Pasta Polo is a family-owned Italian restaurant that has been a Coquitlam neighbourhood fixture since 2001, built around made-from-scratch pasta, slow-simmered sauces, and locally sourced ingredients. The casual dining room is backed by a full bar offering craft beers, cocktails, and an extensive Italian-focused wine list. Beyond the restaurant, the owners are active community contributors, including serving hundreds of portions of homemade chili at the annual CPKC Holiday Train fundraiser.
